A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar, the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-lukesx34landspeeder-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (10 August 2016): Same words as the previous version. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a white italic “E” at the lower right. The slip replaces the full card image.

Lower part of the previous card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
